name: vscode-tars-review
description: Review the workspace with the TARS agent-2 reviewer and show findings as inline editor comments.

tars-review.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the `review-cli` binary. If empty, defaults to `${workspaceFolder}/target/debug/review-cli`. Build it with `cargo build --bin review-cli`.

tars-review.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of .rs files to review in one run (guards against huge workspaces / API cost).

tars-review.reviewActiveFileOnly.description: If true, review only the active editor's file instead of the whole workspace.
